deviations: Offscreen tram bell at f8 (0.333 s), as gag-route places it; the brief's 0.35 s is f8.4, within 1 frame. Panned LEFT per U1 (V enters L->R from behind her).
Syllable clicks follow U1's compressed timing DOU f254 (10.583 s) ... TAN f275 (11.458 s), not the brief's 10.6-11.9 s.
The 0.25 s hold after the contact is f328-333 (13.667-13.917 s): the 75 ms contact clack (f326-327) finishes first, then total silence.
Cut B has no 13.6 s impact or hold (she joins the queue; no collision); it keeps the 7.667-8.000 s silence because frames 0-191 are identical to A.
how_to_mix: Beds are placed as windows (beds); one-shots as cues. All layers are multiplied by a gate that is exactly 0 inside each hold (4 ms ramp before; the 8.0 s jump-cut bed starts hard with a 2 ms ramp). build_sound.py renders it with kit.Mix (add + master). Gains are linear, pan -1 left..+1 right as kit.Mix.add.

absences.searched: Moving Image Archive cache: clips with source sound whose title/queries match street|traffic|city|horse|tram|trolley|bell|crowd|paris|bus|carriage|paper|market|square|town (47 hits), plus every pre-1964 'sound'-kind clip ranked by spectral flatness (40)
absences.result: spectrograms checked: nearly all carry narration, music or crowd speech (Formations 1936, Coney Island, Uruguay 1949, Golden Gate City, This Is My Railroad 1940, Day at the Fair 1947, Boulder Dam, Look to Lockheed 1940...). Only Valley Town (1940) a11ba534 is a clean non-vocal roar; it was used for the tunnel in round 3 but dropped in repair round 1 (clip identity vs the PD Prelinger item not confirmable) and replaced by synthesis. Third Avenue El (14c8b94b) is a clean train rumble but its year/rights are not in the index and the film (1955) is not known to be PD: rejected.

absences.searched: Commons audio: 'Paris street ambience', 'place Paris ambiance', 'city square soundscape', 'street ambience'
absences.result: only La rue Soufflot (Paris) fits (CC BY-SA 3.0); no pre-1964 Paris street recording under an allowed licence was found. Clichy's 'busier square' is built from two real recordings (Soufflot + Vienna fiaker stand).

absences.searched: Commons audio: 'tram bell', 'streetcar bell', 'hand bell', 'tram Glocke'
absences.result: no horse-tram or Paris tram bell; used a modern Sydney tram warning bell (CC BY-SA 4.0) and kept the 19th-c. horse-drawn fire-engine hand bell (CC BY 4.0) as alternate. De-Handglocke.ogg rejected: it is a spoken pronunciation (voice).
no domino/card-tile clack recording under an allowed licence; domino ticks and tile clicks are pitched copies of one real paper transient (scissor snip / page edge).
no clean footsteps on cobbles; used real footsteps on a spiral staircase (CC BY-SA 4.0). Praha cobble ambience (PD, 341 s, 6.6 MB) skipped for size.
no voice of any kind is used (no TTS, no child's voice, crowd-walla clips rejected).
